newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates finish lower, at 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates finish lower, at 18 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed at 18 percent on Friday with banks awash with excess liquidity as the market approached the end of the current two-week reserve period, dealers said.
On Thursday overnight rates finished at 19.625 percent.
"Banks filled their reserves quite full at the beginning of the reserve period and now they face excess liquidity," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
Another dealer added that the market's liquidity was boosted by tax refunds by the state.
